From: nora.kapoor@stanford.edu
To: support@clinicverse.com
Subject: Question about research study enrollment criteria
Date: 2025-09-03T15:20:00Z

Hello,

I am a research coordinator at Stanford Medical Center working on a Phase III clinical trial for a new diabetes medication (Protocol #SC-2025-DIAB-001).

I have a few questions about your system:

1. Can your platform handle electronic informed consent documents?
2. Do you support integration with REDCap for data capture?
3. What formats do you accept for adverse event reports?

We are evaluating vendor solutions for our upcoming trial and would appreciate any information you can provide.

Timeline: We need to make a decision by October 15, 2025.

Best regards,
Nora Kapoor
Research Coordinator
Stanford Medical Center
nora.kapoor@stanford.edu
(650) 555-0142
